**refuse**

The requested kinematics cannot be realized with a 2.2 GeV beam. For electron‑proton scattering the invariant mass is bounded by  

\[
W^{2}=M_{p}^{2}+2M_{p}E_{\text{beam}}-Q^{2},
\]

where \(M_{p}=0.938\;\text{GeV}\). With \(E_{\text{beam}}=2.2\;\text{GeV}\) and \(Q^{2}=3.0\;\text{GeV}^{2}\),

\[
W_{\text{max}}^{2}=0.938^{2}+2\times0.938\times2.2-3.0\approx2.01\;\text{GeV}^{2},
\qquad
W_{\text{max}}\approx1.42\;\text{GeV},
\]

which is well below the requested \(W=2.0\;\text{GeV}\). Hence the kinematic point is unphysical and the code cannot be run for these parameters.
